name: timebase

scripts.update: npm update web-futures --save && npm run update:meta
scripts.update:meta: node scripts/extract-data.js && node scripts/extract-bcd-data.js && node scripts/developer-signals.js && node scripts/interop.js && node scripts/mdn-docs.js && node scripts/chrome-content.js
scripts.stop: kill $(lsof -t -i:8080) || echo 'No server running on port 8080'
scripts.build: npm run update:meta &&node scripts/build.js && node scripts/build-bcd.js
scripts.dev: npm run stop && npm run build && npm run start

description: Timeline of web features and browser support
